answer: In an AI-agent economy, sybil attacks are resisted through progressive stake bonding: every new identity must lock a rising fraction of tokens drawn from the collective ocean of active capital. To climb toward the zenith of voting power or resource allocation, an attacker must immobilize ever-larger amounts for each clone. When peers detect coordinated fakes, the bonded stakes are burned, converting the attacker’s investment into a worthless relic and making large-scale identity forgery economically prohibitive.
